In this episode, I sit down with Kyle, who’s currently making $42k/mo passively with simple no-code apps. If you’re curious about app development, how to make an app, or want to hear a real-life success story from someone who's built a sustainable business model using app ideas, this conversation is for you.

Kyle shares how he got started in mobile app development, how he built without heavy coding or deep programming knowledge, and how anyone — even beginners — can follow his path. Whether you’re exploring app development for beginners or looking to refine your app development roadmap, Kyle’s insights are incredibly valuable.

We dive deep into the process behind how to develop an app, how to create an app, and what it takes to become a successful software developer or entrepreneur in the software development space. Kyle also talks about finding the right business ideas, exploring new business ideas, and leveraging full stack development where needed.
